reason: My first question is always whether it's actually tested, and here the lab is named and the report for my batch is behind the QR code. The pre-counted sachet also fixes my problem of forgetting vitamins on the counter, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy.
objection: Anyone can say they're tested. I would still want to open the report and see that the batch number really matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the report on the product page was missing, didn't match the batch number, or the lab turned out to be unknown, I would skip it.
